headline: Islanders’ Pageau out with lower-body injury, Maccelli, Pulock return to lineup
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Islanders center Jean-Gabriel Pageau is out with a lower-body injury, while Matias Maccelli and Noah Pulock return to the lineup. Pageau has a goal and seven assists in 17 games this season.

The bigger question is what this does to a team that has been outplayed more than its record suggests. NYI sit at 7-6-4 with 18 points, but they hold only 45.8% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) so far this season. At five-on-five that improves to 49%, which is close to even, so the gap comes from special teams. Their power play creates 0.58 expected goals per game, and the penalty kill gives up 0.9 per game, a rough trade. Goaltending has carried them: the team has saved 11.1 goals more than expected, while scoring 3.7 fewer than the chances called for. Those two numbers are why the standings look fine while the underlying play does not. Losing a regular center from a lineup that leans on its goalie is worth watching. We don't have a projection for who takes his minutes, so we'll wait to see how the lines shake out.
